VeriDNS differential-testing rig -- captured verification
Generated: 2026-07-15T15:03:51Z

Addressing: rig on 203.0.113.0/24 (TEST-NET-3); client/attacker on
192.168.53.99. Both are forced by veri-dns's own ACLs -- doNotQueryNets
(egress) excludes the auth servers from RFC1918, defaultAcl (ingress)
requires the client to BE RFC1918. See review/HARNESS.md section 2.1.
The shipped egress filter is ACTIVE: VERI_DNS_ALLOW_LOOPBACK_EGRESS is NOT set.

All queries issued from the attacker namespace (192.168.53.99).

RESULT: both resolvers resolve the fake hierarchy and AGREE:
  example.test      A -> 203.0.113.100   (both)
  host.example.test A -> 203.0.113.101   (both)
veri-dns answers over UDP and TCP.

KNOWN DIFFERENTIAL (pre-existing, not a rig defect): www.example.test
returns the CNAME target with mangled case from veri-dns
(ExAMPlE.TEst.) vs lowercase from unbound -- consistent with findings
